title: 4-rank distribution of Picard groups of hyperelliptic curves via $C$-symmetric matrices
summary: We determine the large-genus limiting distribution of the 4-rank of the Picard group of hyperelliptic curves over a fixed finite field $\mathbb F_q$ of odd characteristic. This is a function field analogue of a result of Fouvry and Klüners. Our computation agrees with (the Picard group analogue of) the Cohen--Lenstra--Gerth heuristics in the case $q \equiv 3\pmod{4}$, i.e., in the absence of roots of unity in the base field.
